en: Midnight. The Temple wall.
A shadow crosses the wall. Then another. And a third, smaller one, that hesitates before jumping.
Inside, the disciples' dormitory.
Twenty mats in a row. Nineteen disciples asleep.
Surround. Wait. Close. Surround. Wait. Close…
Three days until the novices' trial. If I pass, I get my staff.
*(asleep)* Ren… switch that head off. I can hear you thinking from here.
Gon sleeps like a rock. I never sleep the night before anything.
The sliding door opens without a sound.
Playing from memory again?
Master! No… I couldn't sleep.
Good. Tonight I need you awake.
Abbot Hōshin has seen seventy winters, and his voice has never trembled. Tonight, his hands do.
And there's grey dust on his sleeves. Where is he coming from at this hour?
Someone jumped the wall. Go see who dares.
Me? Shouldn't we wake Master Mei?
Mei has another watch tonight. And no one else needs to wake up.
Why?
Because a Temple that shouts at night is a Temple that's afraid. And we are not afraid.
If it's one, you're enough.
If there are more… don't shout. Come back for me.
Yes, Master.
Ren came to the Temple wrapped in a blanket, on a night of grey rain. It was the Abbot who lifted him from the step.
Sixteen years later, the blanket is still folded at the bottom of his trunk. He never learned who wove it.
He's looked after me my whole life. Tonight it's my turn.
zh: 午夜。寺墙。
一道黑影翻过寺墙。接着又是一道。还有第三道，小一些，跳之前犹豫了一下。
寺内，弟子们的寝舍。
二十张草席排成一列。十九个弟子在熟睡。
围住。等待。合拢。围住。等待。合拢……
再过三天就是沙弥试炼。过了，我就能领到棍子。
*（睡梦中）*仁……把你那脑袋关了。我在这儿都听得见你在想事。
刚睡得像块石头。每逢大事前一晚，我都睡不着。
拉门无声地开了。
又在默背棋局？
师父！没……我睡不着。
正好。今晚我需要你醒着。
法真方丈已历七十个寒冬，声音从未颤抖过。今晚，他的手在抖。
袖子上还沾着灰色的尘。这个时辰，他是从哪儿回来的？
有人翻墙进来了。去看看是谁这么大胆。
我？不叫醒梅师父吗？
梅今晚另有守夜的差事。其他人谁也不必醒。
为什么？
因为夜里大喊大叫的寺院，是心怀恐惧的寺院。而我们不怕。
若只有一个，你足够了。
若不止一个……别喊。回来找我。
是，师父。
仁是裹着一条毯子来到寺里的，那是一个下着灰雨的夜晚。是方丈亲手把他从台阶上抱起来的。
十六年过去，那条毯子仍叠放在他的箱底。他始终不知道是谁织的。
他照顾了我一辈子。今晚轮到我了。

en: The wall, a moment later.
Stop! Don't run!
You fight well for someone barefoot, little monk.
What did you come to steal?
Nothing. I came to leave something.
The ninja leaps, and the night swallows him.
Leave something?
On the wall's stone there's a fresh mark, drawn in charcoal: six dots around one.
Like a Leader surrounded on the board…
No. I've seen this somewhere else.
Later. The dormitory.
Nineteen disciples asleep. Ren opens his trunk without a sound.
In one corner of the blanket, stitched in grey thread, is a design he's seen a thousand times without ever really looking.
Six dots around one.
…Who stitched it?
And why would a ninja leave the same design on our wall?
zh: 片刻之后，寺墙。
站住！别想跑！
光着脚还挺能打嘛，小和尚。
你来偷什么？
什么也不偷。我是来留下点东西的。
忍者一跃，便被夜色吞没。
留下东西？
墙石上有一个新画的印记，是用木炭画的：六个点围着一个点。
就像棋盘上被围住的首领……
不。我在别处见过这个。
稍后。寝舍。
十九个弟子在熟睡。仁悄无声息地打开箱子。
毯子一角，用灰线绣着一个图案。他看过上千次，却从没认真看过。
六个点围着一个点。
……是谁绣的？
为什么一个忍者会在我们墙上留下同样的图案？

en: Morning. The training yard.
The sun beats down on the wooden posts. In the yard, no one talks about anything else: last night, ninjas got into the Temple.
Ren! Did you hear?
Hear what?
I caught a scout in the forest at dawn. All by myself.
By yourself? And that bandaged arm?
…I fell. Chasing him.
Gon never falls.
Heard yours got away.
He jumped the wall. I didn't make it.
I know. The whole Temple knows.
This time the Abbot congratulated me.
You earned it, Gon. Really.
Two words, he gave me. “Well done.” He'd have given Ren ten.
And no one can know where I was before dawn.
Enough chatter.
Before he's questioned, the Abbot wants to see how Ren fights him.
Ren? I'm the one who caught him!
That's why you rest today. With that arm, besides.
They bring in the prisoner, wrists bound. He's the age of an older brother, with the smile of someone who isn't afraid.
It's the one from the wall. The one who left the mark.
With his hands tied he can't use Kawarimi. Fight fair anyway, Ren.
Tied up and all, I'll still beat you, little monk.
Sleep well? I didn't. Your cells leak.
zh: 早晨。练武场。
阳光照在木桩上。院子里人人都在议论同一件事：昨夜有忍者闯进了寺院。
仁！你听说了吗？
听说什么？
天亮时我在林子里抓到一个斥候。就我一个人。
你一个人？那胳膊上的绷带怎么回事？
……摔的。追他的时候。
刚从来不会摔跤。
听说你那个跑了。
他翻墙跑了。我没赶上。
我知道。全寺都知道了。
这次方丈夸的是我。
这是你应得的，刚。真的。
他只跟我说了两个字。“很好。”换作仁，他能说上十句。
而且谁也不能知道，天亮前我在哪儿。
别聊了。
审问之前，方丈想看看仁跟他交手如何。
仁？人是我抓的！
所以今天你休息。何况你那条胳膊。
囚犯被押了上来，双手被绑。他像个兄长的年纪，脸上挂着无所畏惧的笑。
是墙上那个。留下印记的那个。
手被绑着，他用不了替身术。你还是要堂堂正正地打，仁。
就算绑着，我也赢得了你，小和尚。
睡得好吗？我可没睡好。你们的牢房漏雨。

en: The yard, at noon.
Good. You surround patiently. That's what matters.
Master, why do we always surround?
Why not just strike? It'd be faster.
I asked my master the same question. I was your age.
And what did she say?
“Because that's how we were taught.”
That's not an answer.
No. It isn't.
She died without answering it. I promised myself I wouldn't do the same.
And here I am. Doing the same.
I'd never seen her lower her eyes.
In the clan we surround too, you know.
You do?
My grandmother said it isn't a fight. It's a prayer.
A prayer to whom?
She never said. She died last winter, coughing.
She coughed grey, little monk. Like ash.
The mark on the wall. Six dots around one. What does it mean?
Where else have you seen it?
He asked that too fast.
I'll make you a trade. You tell me where you saw it, and I'll tell you what I came for.
Ren. We don't bargain with prisoners.
Think it over. Tonight they bring me cold rice. If you want, bring it yourself.
zh: 正午，练武场。
很好。你包围得很有耐心。这才是关键。
师父，我们为什么总是包围？
为什么不直接出手？那样更快。
我也问过我师父同样的问题。那时我跟你一般大。
她怎么回答的？
“因为我们就是这么学的。”
这不算回答。
对。不算。
她到死都没回答。我向自己发誓，绝不像她那样。
可如今的我，还是一样。
我从没见过她垂下眼睛。
我们族里也包围，你知道吗？
你们也是？
我奶奶说那不是打斗。是祈祷。
向谁祈祷？
她从没说过。她去年冬天走了，是咳着走的。
她咳出来的是灰色的，小和尚。像灰烬。
墙上的印记。六个点围着一个点。那是什么意思？
你还在哪儿见过？
他问得太快了。
跟你做个交易。你告诉我在哪儿见过，我告诉你我来干什么。
仁。不跟囚犯讲条件。
考虑一下。今晚他们会给我送冷饭。你愿意的话，就你来送。

en: That afternoon. The road to the village.
Ren heads down to the village for rice. The empty basket bumps against his back.
“Where else have you seen it?” He asked like his life depended on it.
A grandmother who coughed ash. Grey dust on the Master's sleeves. A mark on the wall, and on my blanket.
None of it makes sense. And all of it rhymes.
So quiet…
Not a bird. Not the wind. The forest holds its breath.
Three shadows drop from the trees. Before they touch the ground, they've surrounded him.
It's him. The Abbot's disciple.
You know me?
The whole clan knows the blanket boy.
…The blanket.
What do you know about my blanket?
That it's worth exactly one captured scout.
We're taking you to the pagoda. Tomorrow the Temple gives us back Sora, and you go home.
Sora? Is that his name?
Without hurting him. The Shogun was clear.
The Shogun doesn't know we're here. Surround him!
zh: 那天下午。去村子的路上。
仁下山去村里买米。空篮子拍打着他的背。
“你还在哪儿见过？”他问得像是性命攸关。
一个咳出灰烬的奶奶。师父袖子上的灰尘。墙上的印记，还有我毯子上的。
这些都说不通。可每一件都彼此相像。
好安静……
没有鸟叫。没有风声。整片树林屏住了呼吸。
三道黑影从树上落下。还没落地，就已将他围住。
是他。方丈的弟子。
你们认识我？
全族都认识那个裹毯子的孩子。
……毯子。
你们知道我毯子的什么事？
知道它正好值一个被抓的斥候。
我们带你去宝塔。明天寺院把空还给我们，你就能回家。
空？他叫这个名字？
别伤着他。将军说得很清楚。
将军不知道我们在这儿。围住他！

en: The road, at sunset.
Why doesn't your Shogun want me hurt?
What's this about the blanket boy? Answer me!
I'm not the one you should be asking.
Ask the old man what he keeps down below. And what he found on the step sixteen years ago.
Down below?
The basket lies overturned. The rice is scattered across the road.
Three ninjas defy their Shogun for one scout.
I'll gather it anyway. If no one brings him dinner, I will.
zh: 日落时分，路上。
你们将军为什么不让人伤我？
“裹毯子的孩子”是什么意思？回答我！
你该问的人不是我。
去问那个老头，他在下面藏了什么。还有十六年前，他在台阶上捡到了什么。
下面？
篮子翻倒了。米撒了一路。
三个忍者为了一个斥候，违抗他们的将军。
还是捡起来吧。要是没人给他送晚饭，我来送。

en: Night. The Temple cells.
Beneath the old wing of the Temple burns a single torch. Behind the bars, someone is awake.
I brought you rice.
…Poisoned?
Just dirt. Your friends knocked it all over the road.
My friends?
Three of them. They wanted to trade me for you.
…Idiots. The Shogun's going to hang them by their thumbs.
Did they hurt you?
No. They had orders not to.
Thanks for the rice. My name's Sora.
I know. They shouted it.
They called me “the blanket boy.” What do you people know about me?
Less than you think. More than we should.
My blanket has the mark you left on the wall stitched into it.
Sora stops eating.
…Six dots around one?
In grey thread. In one corner.
Then it was true. She was right.
Who?
No, kid. If I tell you, you won't believe me. You have to see it.
My little sister is just like you. Questions and more questions. Someday you two will meet.
A dull thud on the roof. Then another.
…No. I told her not to come.
Ren! They've come to break him out! They're on the roof!
zh: 夜。寺里的牢房。
寺院旧翼下只点着一支火把。铁栏后面，有人没睡。
我给你带了米饭。
……下了毒？
只有点土。你的同伙在路上把它打翻了。
我的同伙？
三个。他们想拿我换你。
……一群蠢货。将军会把他们吊着大拇指挂起来。
他们伤着你了吗？
没有。他们奉命不准伤我。
谢谢你的饭。我叫空。
我知道。他们喊出来了。
他们叫我“裹毯子的孩子”。你们到底知道我什么？
比你想的少。比我们该知道的多。
我的毯子上绣着你留在墙上的那个印记。
空停下了筷子。
……六个点围着一个点？
灰线绣的。在一角。
那就是真的了。她说对了。
谁？
不行，小子。我说了你也不会信。你得亲眼看见。
我妹妹跟你一样。问个不停。总有一天你们会见面的。
屋顶上一声闷响。接着又一声。
……不。我跟她说了别来。
仁！他们来救他了！在屋顶上！

en: The smoke clears. The cells.
The rescuers fled across the roof. They left the prisoner behind.
Your friends abandoned you.
They didn't come to get me out. They came to distract you.
Distract me from what?
From the one who really came. Right now she's fighting your Master Mei in the hallway upstairs.
Listen, there's no time. We didn't come to steal.
**We came to warn you.**
Warn us about what?
What your Abbot keeps down below…
The torch goes out on its own. A cold mist seeps in under the door.
At the cell door stands a white fox. No one saw it come in.
It is not yet time for him to know.
…Yes, my lady.
My lady? You're talking to a fox?
He listens to me. That's more than most men do.
Eat the rice yourself, blanket boy. You'll need it.
Wait! Do you know who stitched my blanket?
When the stone beats, you'll know.
The fox and the prisoner vanish into the mist.
The cell is still shut. Locked. From the outside.
What stone?
zh: 烟雾散去。牢房。
救人的忍者从屋顶逃了。囚犯被留了下来。
你的同伙丢下你了。
他们不是来救我的。是来引开你的。
引开我？为了什么？
为了真正要来的那个人。她这会儿正在楼上走廊里跟你们梅师父交手。
听着，没时间了。我们不是来偷东西的。
**我们是来警告的。**
警告什么？
你们方丈藏在下面的东西……
火把自己熄灭了。一股冰冷的雾从门缝下渗进来。
牢门口站着一只白狐。没有人看见它进来。
还不是让他知道的时候。
……是，大人。
大人？你在跟一只狐狸说话？
他肯听我说话。大多数人可做不到。
米饭你自己吃吧，裹毯子的孩子。你会用得上。
等等！你知道是谁绣了我的毯子吗？
等石头跳动时，你就会知道。
白狐和囚犯消失在雾中。
牢门依旧紧闭。上了锁。从外面锁的。
什么石头？

en: Minutes later. The north wall.
They're all over the wall! They're covering someone's escape.
Gon, did you see a fox? Or the prisoner?
What fox? The prisoner's gone! And the cell was still locked!
Ren, if they get over the north wall, they head straight down to the village.
…Hana.
My sister's eight. She sleeps right by the road.
So not one of them gets through. Not one.
Gon. Your arm. You didn't fall.
Later. If we get out of this, I'll tell you.
Focus, Ren! There are a lot of them, and the night is long.
zh: 几分钟后。北墙。
墙上到处都是！他们在掩护某个人逃跑。
刚，你看见一只狐狸了吗？还是那个囚犯？
什么狐狸？囚犯不见了！牢门还锁着！
仁，要是他们翻过北墙，就会直接下到村子里。
我妹妹才八岁。就睡在路边。
所以一个也别想过去。一个也不行。
刚。你的胳膊。你不是摔的。
以后再说。要是我们能活着过了今晚，我就告诉你。
集中精神，仁！他们人多，夜还长着呢。

en: The ninjas retreat into the forest. The wall falls silent.
Running like rabbits!
Your arm, Gon.
The other night the Abbot woke me. Just me. He sent me to guard the crypt stairs.
He said: “No one goes down. And don't tell anyone. Not even Ren.”
Not even me.
A ninja came. A little one, with a fan. She beat me in three moves.
And before going down, she apologized.
She went down?
All the way to the stone door. Then the bells rang and she left.
That's why I went hunting for the scout. I couldn't come back empty-handed.
Don't tell anyone, Ren.
That you lost?
That I'm scared of what's down there.
“We came to warn you.” “What he keeps down below.” A staircase I'm not allowed to know about.
Tomorrow I'll ask the Abbot. Even if he gets angry.
zh: 忍者们退回林中。寺墙归于寂静。
跑得跟兔子似的！
胳膊，刚。
前几天夜里，方丈把我叫醒。只叫了我一个。他让我去守地穴的阶梯。
他说：“谁也不准下去。也别告诉任何人。连仁也不行。”
连我也不行。
来了一个忍者。个子小小的，拿着扇子。三招就把我打败了。
下去之前，她还向我道了歉。
她下去了？
一直到石门前。后来钟声响了，她就走了。
所以我才去抓那个斥候。我不能空着手回来。
别告诉任何人，仁。
说你输了？
说我害怕下面的东西。
“我们是来警告的。”“他藏在下面的东西。”一道不许我知道的阶梯。
明天我去问方丈。就算他会发火。

en: Dawn. The main gate.
The morning mist covers the steps. Someone waits at the gate, alone. He isn't hiding.
The blanket boy.
Why does everyone call me that? Who are you?
Kuro. The one who stays behind so the others make it home.
I hear you surround well. That you brought rice to a prisoner.
A monk feeding a ninja… You don't see that often.
Did they make it? Sora and the one with the fan.
…You know too much for a novice.
And I understand nothing. What do you want from the Temple?
What's ours. The Jade Scroll. Today, or next time.
The Scroll is sacred. No one takes it out of the library.
Have you ever seen it?
Neither have I. Neither of us is defending something we've seen.
Let's at least make the fight worth it.
zh: 黎明。正门。
晨雾笼罩着台阶。有人独自等在门口。他没有躲藏。
裹毯子的孩子。
为什么人人都这么叫我？你是谁？
黑。殿后的人，好让其他人能回家。
听说你包围得不错。还给囚犯送过饭。
和尚给忍者送饭……这可不常见。
他们回去了吗？空，还有拿扇子的那个。
……作为一个小沙弥，你知道得太多了。
可我什么都不明白。你们想从寺里得到什么？
属于我们的东西。翡翠卷轴。今天拿不到，就下次。
卷轴是神圣的。谁也不能把它带出藏经阁。
你见过它吗？
我也没有。我们俩守护的，都是自己没见过的东西。
那至少让这一战值得吧。

en: Well fought. Better than any of mine at your age.
But you understand nothing about what you defend.
Then explain it to me!
Not my place. Sixteen years ago I swore never to tell.
Sixteen years? You were…?
Ask your master who left you on the step. And look him in the eye when he answers.
Wait!
Later. The Abbot's chamber.
Master, the ninjas say they've come to warn us.
They talk about something we keep down below. You had Gon guard the crypt and forbade him to tell me.
Gon talks too much.
And my blanket has the wall's mark stitched into it. Six dots around one.
The Abbot doesn't answer. For the first time in sixteen years, he doesn't look Ren in the eye.
“Look him in the eye when he answers.”
Master. Who left me on the step?
**Forget it.** That is an order.
He's never shouted at me before.
The floor trembles, barely.
Grey dust falls from the ceiling.
Master…?
It isn't dust. It's **ash**.
The same thing he had on his sleeves that night.
It has begun.
Just like the night she placed him in my arms.
zh: 打得好。比我手下任何人在你这年纪时都强。
可你根本不明白自己在守护什么。
那你就告诉我！
轮不到我说。十六年前我发过誓，绝不说出去。
十六年？你当时也在……？
去问你师父，是谁把你放在台阶上的。他回答时，看着他的眼睛。
等等！
稍后。方丈的房间。
师父，忍者说他们是来警告的。
他们说我们在下面藏着东西。您让刚守着地穴，还不准他告诉我。
刚话太多了。
我的毯子上还绣着墙上那个印记。六个点围着一个点。
方丈没有回答。十六年来第一次，他没有看仁的眼睛。
“他回答时，看着他的眼睛。”
师父。是谁把我放在台阶上的？
**忘了它。**这是命令。
他从没对我吼过。
地面微微颤动。
灰色的尘从屋顶落下。
师父……？
那不是尘。是**灰烬**。
跟那天夜里他袖子上的一样。
开始了。
就像她把他放进我怀里的那一夜。

en: Two days later. The mountain stairs, before dawn.
Since the night of the ash, the Abbot won't speak to him. Neither will Mei. Gon has been sent to guard the crypt day and night.
Ren walks down the stairs with a bundle on his shoulder. Inside, the blanket.
“Ask the old man what he keeps down below.” I asked. He shouted at me.
If no one in the Temple will answer me, I'll find someone outside who will.
Sneaking out, kid? *hic*
Master Tao!
I didn't see a thing. I never see a thing. It's my greatest talent. *hic*
Are you going to tell the Abbot?
The Abbot? The Abbot and I haven't said anything important to each other in sixteen years.
Sixteen years. That number again.
What's in that bundle?
…My blanket.
Tao stops smiling. For a moment, he looks like he's never had a drink in his life.
Keep it safe. And don't show it to just anyone.
I'll walk you as far as the river. No farther.
Why no farther?
Because I'm old. And because I swore it. *hic*
Among the pines, someone is watching them. Clan scouts, spying on the Temple since the night of the wall.
Ah. We have an audience. Go on, kid. I'll clap.
zh: 两天后。山间石阶，天亮之前。
自从落灰那一夜，方丈就不再跟他说话。梅也是。刚被派去日夜看守地穴。
仁肩上挎着一个包袱走下石阶。里面是那条毯子。
「去问那个老头，他在下面藏了什么。」我问了。他冲我吼。
既然寺里没人肯回答我，我就去外面找人问。
偷偷溜出去啊，小子？*嗝*
陶师父！
我什么都没看见。我从来什么都看不见。这是我最大的本事。*嗝*
您会告诉方丈吗？
方丈？我跟方丈已经十六年没说过一句要紧话了。
十六年。又是这个数字。
你那包袱里装的什么？
……我的毯子。
陶的笑容消失了。有那么一刻，他看起来像这辈子滴酒未沾。
收好它。别随便给人看。
我送你到河边。再远就不行了。
为什么不能再远？
因为我老了。也因为我发过誓。*嗝*
松林间，有人在盯着他们。是一族的斥候，自翻墙那夜起就一直在监视寺院。
啊。有观众了。去吧，小子。我来鼓掌。

en: The path, farther on.
The scouts flee. They leave tracks in the mud: light feet, the kind that don't want to be seen.
They're heading east. To the old shrine.
There's a shrine to the east? I've never heard of it.
Because the Temple doesn't like to name it. There are stones there that tell what the Temple keeps quiet.
Have you seen them?
I see little. I drink a lot. *hic*
But the last time someone followed these tracks was sixteen years ago.
A young monk, the best of his generation. He went down the mountain with questions.
And what happened to him?
He came back without his robe. The Abbot threw him out that same night.
The same night you showed up on the step.
For someone who forgot everything, you read tracks very well. And dates.
zh: 小路，再往前。
斥候们逃走了。泥里留下脚印：脚步很轻，是不想被人看见的那种。
往东去了。去老神社。
东边有神社？我从没听说过。
因为寺里不愿提它。那里有些石头，会说出寺院不肯说的事。
您见过吗？
我见得少。喝得多。*嗝*
不过上一次有人追着这些脚印走，是十六年前。
一个年轻和尚，同辈里最出色的。他带着疑问下了山。
后来呢？
他回来时已经没了僧袍。方丈当晚就把他赶走了。
就是你出现在台阶上的那一夜。
一个什么都忘了的人，脚印倒是读得很清楚。日子也记得很清楚。

en: The only bridge over the river.
The river roars below. On the other side, clan land begins.
The ninjas block the bridge from end to end.
Master, will you help me?
I don't go past here. This river is my border.
Whose border?
Mine and the Abbot's. We swore it together, one night when the rain fell grey.
He swore never to speak of that night again. I swore never to cross this bridge again.
He kept his word. So did I. And look how well it turned out. *hic*
…It can't be.
The blanket boy! You again!
It's the one from the road. The one who wanted to trade me for Sora.
What are you doing here?
The Shogun punished us for disobeying. A month guarding this bridge, eating raw fish.
All because of you.
Because of me? You ambushed me!
Details. This time there are no orders to protect you. Well, there are. But not to let you through.
It's going to be a long battle, kid! And there's nowhere to retreat!
Thanks, Master!
Anytime! *hic*
zh: 河上唯一的桥。
河水在下方咆哮。对岸就是一族的地界。
忍者们把桥从头到尾堵死了。
师父，您能帮我吗？
我不过这儿。这条河是我的边界。
谁的边界？
我的，也是方丈的。那晚下着灰雨，我们一起发的誓。
他发誓再也不提那一夜。我发誓再也不过这座桥。
他守住了。我也守住了。瞧瞧我们落得什么下场。*嗝*
……不会吧。
裹毯子的孩子！又是你！
是路上那个。想拿我换空的那个。
你在这儿干什么？
将军罚我们违抗命令。守这座桥一个月，吃生鱼。
全都怪你。
怪我？是你们伏击我的！
细节而已。这次没有命令要护着你。好吧，有。但没说要放你过去。
这一仗会很长，小子！而且无路可退！
谢谢师父！
不客气！*嗝*

en: The far bank.
I made it!
You made it. Now the Shogun's going to give me another month.
Why does your Shogun protect me? Tell me and I'll leave you alone.
Because you're a debt.
That's all I know. He said it himself, the night you arrived at the Temple. I was a little girl.
“The clan owes that boy a life. And the clan pays what it owes.”
On the other side of the river, Tao raises his gourd in a toast.
I never doubted you!
Well. A little.
Kid! If you find a ronin with a scar on his eyebrow, tell him something from me.
Tell him what?
That Tao still keeps his bowl. And that it wasn't his fault.
What wasn't his fault?
zh: 对岸。
我过来了！
你过来了。这下将军又要罚我一个月了。
你们将军为什么护着我？告诉我，我就放过你。
因为你是一笔债。
我只知道这些。是他亲口说的，就在你来到寺里的那一夜。那时我还是个小女孩。
「一族欠那孩子一条命。一族欠的，一定会还。」
河的另一边，陶举起酒葫芦遥遥一敬。
我从没怀疑过你！
好吧。有一点点。
小子！要是你遇到一个眉上有疤的浪人，替我带句话。
什么话？
就说陶还给他留着碗。还有，那不是他的错。
什么不是他的错？

en: The abandoned shrine.
Moss, fallen stones, a torii no one tends. And something carved into the rock.
Six stones in a hexagon, around a horned figure. On one side, a hand holding monk's beads. On the other, a hand holding a tantō.
That's the Temple's symbol…
…and that's the clan's. Both hands close the same circle.
Six dots around one. Like my blanket.
No one's looked at those stones in centuries. What's a monk doing here?
I'm looking for someone who'll tell me the truth.
Wrong place. There's nothing here but stones and a ronin who's lost the will to talk.
Do you have a scar on your eyebrow?
Who sent you?
Tao. He said he still keeps your bowl.
The ronin laughs without joy, like someone receiving a very old letter.
That drunk. Still alive.
This morning I ran into a ninja who said a name I hadn't heard in sixteen years. And now you bring me Tao.
Today the dead feel like talking.
Show me how you fight. If you surround the way Hōshin taught you, we have nothing to say to each other.
zh: 荒废的神社。
青苔，倒下的石块，一座无人照看的鸟居。还有刻在岩石上的东西。
六块石头排成六边形，围着一个长角的身影。一边是一只握着念珠的手。另一边是一只握着短刀的手。
那是寺院的标志……
……那是一族的。两只手合成同一个圆。
六个点围着一个点。就像我的毯子。
几百年没人看过这些石头了。一个和尚来这儿干什么？
我在找一个肯跟我说实话的人。
找错地方了。这里只有石头，和一个懒得开口的浪人。
你眉上有疤吗？
谁派你来的？
陶。他说还给你留着碗。
浪人笑了，笑得毫无兴致，像收到一封很旧很旧的信。
那个酒鬼。还活着。
今早我碰到一个女忍，她说出一个我十六年没听过的名字。现在你又给我带来了陶。
今天，死人都想开口了。
让我看看你怎么打。要是你像法真教的那样包围，我们就没什么好说的。

en: You don't surround like Hōshin. You surround like someone who waits.
I was a monk, you know. They threw me out for asking what the Jade Scroll says.
Tao said they threw you out the night I arrived.
They left me on the Temple step, wrapped in this.
Ren unties the bundle and opens the blanket on the stone.
Six dots around one, in grey thread.
Where did you get this?
I told you. I came wrapped in it.
No. It can't be.
Hōshin told me the baby died that night. With her.
With who?
Jubei doesn't answer. He looks at the blanket as if it burned.
Not tonight. I can't.
Tomorrow I'll tell you everything. I swear it, kid.
Everyone swears something. No one tells me anything.
zh: 你包围的方式不像法真。你包围得像一个在等待的人。
我当过和尚，知道吗？他们把我赶出来，因为我问了翡翠卷轴上写着什么。
陶说，他们赶走你的那一夜，正是我来的那一夜。
他们把我放在寺院的台阶上，就裹着这个。
仁解开包袱，把毯子摊在石头上。
六个点围着一个点，灰线绣的。
这是从哪儿来的？
我说过了。我来的时候就裹着它。
不。不可能。
法真跟我说，那孩子当晚就死了。和她一起。
和谁？
十兵卫没有回答。他盯着毯子，像是被烫到了。
今晚不行。我做不到。
明天我把一切都告诉你。我发誓，小子。
人人都在发誓。却没人告诉我任何事。

en: The forest, at night.
Jubei lit a fire and hasn't spoken in hours. Now he looks at Ren as if searching for something in his face.
Did Hōshin treat you well?
Like a son. He taught me to read, to surround, to not be afraid.
…Good. That's good.
He was always a better teacher than a man.
Why do you care so much how he treated me?
Because…
Among the bamboo, a shadow. Two. Four.
They followed you from the shrine. Those aren't scouts: they're the Shogun's shinobi.
Shinobi slip through any gap.
Then leave no gaps. And stay close to the fire.
zh: 夜晚的森林。
十兵卫生了火，几个时辰没说话。现在他看着仁，像在他脸上寻找什么。
法真待你好吗？
像亲儿子一样。他教我读书，教我包围，教我不要害怕。
……好。那就好。
他当师父，一向比做人强。
你为什么这么在意他怎么待我？
因为……
竹林间，一道黑影。两道。四道。
他们从神社一路跟着你。那不是斥候：是将军的忍者。
忍者会从任何缝隙钻进来。
那就别留缝隙。也别离火太远。

en: A fallen shinobi drops something as he flees: a small scroll tied with red thread.
It has the Shogun's seal.
Read it.
*(reading)* “Bring the Jade Scroll before the new moon. If ash falls, there is no more time to ask for it.”
The new moon is in ten days.
Why the new moon?
Because it's the darkest night. The things that sleep underground feel it.
Sixteen years ago, ash fell too. And it was also ten days before the new moon.
What happened that new moon?
Someone went down into the crypt to do something she didn't know how to do alone.
And I got there too late.
Later. The fire, almost out.
Ren falls asleep wrapped in the blanket. Jubei keeps watch until dawn.
When Ren wakes, the ronin is gone. In his place, a wooden bowl and a note.
*(reading)* “Forgive me. Before I tell you, I have to talk to someone. Wait for me at the shrine the day after tomorrow, at dawn.”
Talk to who? The Abbot?
There's something carved under the bowl. A name: Natsu.
zh: 一个倒下的忍者逃跑时掉了样东西：一卷用红线系着的小卷轴。
上面有将军的印。
念。
*（读着）*「新月之前，带回翡翠卷轴。若落下灰烬，便再无时间去讨。」
离新月还有十天。
为什么是新月？
因为那是最黑的夜。沉睡在地下的东西能感觉到。
十六年前，也落过灰。那时也是离新月还有十天。
那次新月发生了什么？
有人下到地穴，去做一件她一个人做不到的事。
而我去晚了。
稍后。火堆，快要熄了。
仁裹着毯子睡着了。十兵卫守到天亮。
仁醒来时，浪人已经不见了。原地留下一只木碗和一张字条。
*（读着）*「对不起。告诉你之前，我得先去找一个人谈谈。后天天亮，在神社等我。」
找谁？方丈吗？
碗底刻着字。一个名字：夏。

en: The valley. Thick fog.
Nothing stays still in the fog. Ren walks toward the shrine without knowing if he's on the right path.
Natsu. Who is Natsu?
“The baby died that night. With her.” Is Natsu “her”?
Keep going that way and you'll fall in the river, little monk.
You! The one from the cell.
The one from the cell, the wall, the forest. Always the same one. Few look at me twice.
What are you?
The one who remembers.
Then remind me of something. Who is Natsu?
A girl who stitched badly and surrounded well.
Your blanket was begun by an old hand and finished by a young one. Both were trembling.
Why were they trembling?
Because they knew where you were going.
Shapes move in the fog. A clan patrol, combing the valley.
First get out of the valley. Then ask.
zh: 山谷。浓雾。
雾里没有什么是静止的。仁朝神社走去，不知道自己有没有走对。
夏。夏是谁？
「那孩子当晚就死了。和她一起。」夏就是「她」吗？
再往那边走，你就掉进河里了，小和尚。
是你！牢房里那个。
牢房里那个，墙上那个，林子里那个。一直都是同一个。很少有人会多看我一眼。
你是什么？
记得的那个。
那就让我记起一件事。夏是谁？
一个绣得很差、却很会包围的姑娘。
你的毯子，是一只苍老的手起的针，一只年轻的手收的尾。两只手都在发抖。
为什么发抖？
因为她们知道你要去哪里。
雾中有影子在移动。一族的巡逻队，正在搜查山谷。
先出山谷。再问。

en: The valley's edge.
Tomorrow, at the shrine, you'll meet someone who asks the same questions you do.
The ronin? He said he'd wait for me there.
The ronin went looking for an old man who doesn't want to be found.
The one you'll meet comes from the other side.
The other side of the valley?
The other side of the war.
Don't hurt her. She's the only one who can answer you.
And what if she hurts me?
Then you'll both learn fast.
An old hand and a young hand.
Someone stitched me a farewell.
zh: 山谷出口。
明天，在神社，你会遇见一个和你问着同样问题的人。
那个浪人？他说会在那里等我。
浪人去找一个不想被找到的老人了。
你要遇见的人，来自另一边。
山谷的另一边？
战争的另一边。
别伤她。只有她能回答你。
那要是她伤我呢？
那你们俩都会学得很快。
一只苍老的手，一只年轻的手。
有人给我绣了一份告别。

en: The shrine, at dawn.
Two shadows in the same clearing. Neither moves first.
A monk. Alone. In my forest.
It's not your forest. And I didn't come alone: a fox sent me.
…Me too.
You're the one with the fan. The one who beat Gon on the stairs and apologized.
And you're the one who brought my brother rice.
Sora's your brother? He said he had a sister who asked too many questions.
And he said the rice had dirt in it. And that it was the best thing he'd eaten all week.
I'm looking for a ronin. Jubei. He told me to meet him here.
I'm looking for him too. The fox told me to come.
He didn't show.
No.
In the clan they call you the blanket boy. The Shogun guards you like a treasure and won't say why.
Show me that blanket.
Everyone wants something from me and no one gives me anything. Beat me first.
I was going to beat you anyway.
zh: 黎明时分，神社。
同一片空地上，两道身影。谁都没有先动。
一个和尚。独自一人。在我的林子里。
这不是你的林子。我也不是一个人来的：是一只狐狸叫我来的。
……我也是。
你是拿扇子的那个。在石阶上打败刚、还向他道歉的那个。
你是给我哥哥送饭的那个。
空是你哥哥？他说他有个妹妹，问题特别多。
他还说那饭里有土。说那是他一个星期里吃过最香的东西。
我在找一个浪人。十兵卫。他约我在这儿见。
我也在找他。约我来的是狐狸。
他没来。
没来。
族里都叫你裹毯子的孩子。将军把你当宝贝一样护着，却不说为什么。
让我看看那条毯子。
人人都想从我这儿要东西，却没人给我任何东西。先赢了我再说。
反正我也会赢你。

en: You won. This time.
I'll show it to you anyway. I want to see the look on your face.
Ren opens the blanket on the shrine's stone.
Six dots around one, in grey thread.
I know that stitching. Every single stitch.
From where?
My grandmother Kiku stitched it. On the cloth of her board. On the cape for my first mission.
And she only stitched for family.
That crooked stitch in the corner… That one isn't hers. It's from someone who was learning.
“Begun by an old hand and finished by a young one.”
Who is Natsu?
Aya steps back, as if she'd been struck.
Where did you hear that name?
Bells jingle among the trees. A Temple patrol is coming up the path.
Monks. Yours. They're coming for you.
Wait! Answer me!
My mother's sister. My grandmother's youngest daughter.
She died sixteen years ago. That's what her grave says.
A smoke bomb. Aya is gone.
She only stitched for family.
…Then whose family am I?
zh: 你赢了。这一次。
我还是会给你看。我想看看你是什么表情。
仁把毯子摊在神社的石头上。
六个点围着一个点，灰线绣的。
这种绣法我认得。每一针都认得。
在哪儿见过？
我奶奶菊就这么绣。绣在她的棋盘布上。绣在我第一次出任务的披风上。
而且她只给家里人绣。
角上那一针歪的……那不是她绣的。是一个正在学的人绣的。
「一只苍老的手起的针，一只年轻的手收的尾。」
夏是谁？
绫后退一步，像挨了一记。
你在哪儿听到这个名字的？
林间响起铃声。一支寺院的巡逻队正沿小路上山。
和尚。你们的人。来找你了。
等等！回答我！
我母亲的妹妹。我奶奶最小的女儿。
她十六年前就死了。她的墓碑上是这么写的。
一颗烟雾弹。绫已经不见了。
她只给家里人绣。
……那我是谁家的人？

en: The Temple. Ren returns after a week.
The incense still burns, as always. But there are guards where there never were.
Ren! Where have you been?
Outside. Learning things.
The Abbot was furious. He locked the library.
He locked the library?
And he put guards on the crypt. Something's going on.
Let's spar, like before. I missed you.
zh: 寺院。仁在一周后回来了。
香火依旧燃着，一如往常。但以前从没有守卫的地方，如今站着守卫。
仁！你跑哪儿去了？
外面。学了些东西。
方丈大发雷霆。他把藏经阁锁上了。
他锁了藏经阁？
还在地穴派了守卫。出事了。
我们打一场吧，像以前一样。我想你了。

en: You fight differently.
More… like them.
Gon, do you know what's in the crypt?
No one goes down there.
Only Tao.
zh: 你打法变了。
更……像他们。
刚，你知道地穴里有什么吗？
没人下去过。
只有陶。

en: The novices' dormitory.
It's night, and the youngest ones aren't sleeping. They sit together, eyes wide open.
Brother Ren… we dream of fire.
All of you?
All of us. The same dream.
A horned thing beneath our feet.
They're just dreams. Come on, training.
zh: 小沙弥的寝舍。
夜里，最小的几个都没睡。他们挤在一起，眼睛睁得大大的。
仁师兄……我们梦见了火。
你们都梦见了？
都梦见了。同一个梦。
一个长角的东西，在我们脚底下。
只是梦而已。来，去练功。

en: At last the novices fall asleep, exhausted.
A horned figure.
Like in the carvings at the shrine.
zh: 小沙弥们终于累得睡着了。
一个长角的身影。
就像神社石刻上的那样。

en: Midnight. The library.
Ren forces the door. The shelves smell of dust and wax.
Someone stands by the altar. Waiting for him.
I knew you would come.
I want to read the Scroll.
It isn't here.
And if it were, you'd have to get past me first.
zh: 午夜。藏经阁。
仁撬开了门。书架上满是灰尘和蜡的气味。
祭坛旁有人。一直在等他。
我就知道你会来。
我想读那卷卷轴。
它不在这里。
就算在，你也得先过我这一关。

en: There is a seal, Ren. Beneath the Temple.
It is breaking.
And the Abbot?
He says he can renew it alone. That no one else needs to know.
Do you believe him?
zh: 有一道封印，仁。在寺院底下。
它正在破碎。
那方丈呢？
他说他能独自重修封印。说别人不必知道。
您相信他吗？

en: Dawn. The courtyard covered in ash.
Last night's tremor split the courtyard. Grey smoke rises from the crack.
Ninjas on the wall! They're using the chaos!
It's not their fault!
It's coming from below!
zh: 黎明。满是灰烬的庭院。
昨夜的震动在庭院裂开一道缝。灰色的烟从里面冒出来。
墙上有忍者！他们想趁乱进来！
不是他们干的！
是从下面来的！

en: The ninjas withdraw. The ash keeps falling, like dirty snow.
Through the ash, for a moment, Ren sees two red eyes.
…Did you see that?
See what?
zh: 忍者们撤退了。灰烬还在落，像脏了的雪。
灰烬之中，有那么一瞬，仁看见了两只红眼。
……你们看见了吗？
看见什么？

en: The Abbot's hall.
The tremors are the clan's doing.
Kage wants the Scroll to free something he doesn't understand.
Master, Mei said that…
Mei talks too much.
Ren, you will go to the clan's pagoda. You will defeat Kage.
It is the only way to protect the Temple.
Me?
You are the best I have.
zh: 方丈的大殿。
地震是忍者一族搞的鬼。
影想要卷轴，去释放一个他根本不懂的东西。
师父，梅师父说……
梅话太多了。
仁，你去忍者的宝塔。去打败影。
这是保护寺院唯一的办法。
我？
你是我最好的弟子。

en: The corridor, on the way out.
*(quietly)* Ren. Don't go.
It's an order from the Abbot.
Orders can be wrong too.
zh: 出门时的回廊。
*（低声）*仁。别去。
这是方丈的命令。
命令也会出错。

en: The gate, at night.
Ren leaves with nothing but the clothes on his back. On the last step, someone blocks his way.
To the pagoda, kid? *hic*
Let me pass, master.
The old man is using you.
If you fight Kage, no one will be left for what's coming.
What's coming?
For once, Tao doesn't seem drunk.
Beat me and I'll let you go. Lose and you stay.
zh: 夜晚，山门。
仁只身出发。在最后一级台阶上，有人拦住了他。
去宝塔吗，小子？*嗝*
让我过去，师父。
那老头在利用你。
你要是跟影打，就没人能对付接下来的东西了。
接下来的什么？
这一次，陶看起来一点也不醉。
赢了我，我就放你走。输了，你就留下。

en: Bah.
You're as stubborn as Daishin.
Who is Daishin?
Ask Kage. If he lets you talk. *hic*
Ren goes down the mountain. Behind him, the Temple bell stays silent.
zh: 哼。
你和大心一样倔。
大心是谁？
去问影吧。如果他肯让你开口的话。*嗝*
仁走下山去。在他身后，寺院的钟没有响。

en: The clan's pagoda. Five floors.
Ren arrives alone. The door is open, as if they were expecting him.
The Shogun said the Abbot's boy would come.
That he should climb, if he can.
zh: 忍者一族的宝塔。五层。
仁独自到来。大门敞开着，好像早就在等他。
将军说过，方丈的那个小子会来。
让他上来，如果他有本事的话。

en: One floor.
Four to go.
zh: 一层。
还有四层。

en: Second floor. The floor of fans.
Red lanterns, curtains that move without wind. And behind every curtain, an open fan.
Aya told us about you. She said you ask a lot of questions.
Is she here?
She's gone. To the Temple.
While you climb up, she goes down.
zh: 第二层。扇之层。
红灯笼，无风自动的帘幕。每道帘幕后，都有一把张开的扇子。
绫提起过你。她说你问题很多。
她在这儿吗？
她走了。去寺院了。
你往上爬的时候，她正往下走。

en: Aya at the Temple…
And the Abbot, alone?
zh: 绫在寺院……
那方丈岂不是一个人？

en: Third floor. The rafters.
The Tengu leap from beam to beam. They never touch the floor.
Come down and fight!
Two paths, one same night.
Hurry, little monk.
zh: 第三层。梁木之间。
天狗在梁与梁之间跳跃。从不落地。
下来打！
两条路，同一个夜晚。
快点，小和尚。

en: Wait! What's happening at the Temple?
What had to happen.
From the railing, the Temple can be seen far away. Above it, a red light that isn't the dawn.
zh: 等等！寺院出了什么事？
该发生的事。
从栏杆望去，能看见远处的寺院。寺院上空，有一道不是晨光的红光。

en: Fourth floor.
I told you we'd meet again.
I'm not here to steal anything.
I've come to talk to your Shogun.
No one talks to the Shogun without going through me.
zh: 第四层。
我说过我们还会再见。
我不是来偷东西的。
我是来找你们将军谈的。
不过我这一关，谁也别想见将军。

en: Go up.
But when he tells you the truth, you'll wish you hadn't heard it.
zh: 上去吧。
但等他告诉你真相，你会宁愿自己没听过。

en: The last door.
Behind the door, a single breath. Slow.
The Abbot told me to defeat him.
Tao told me to listen to him.
No one enters.
zh: 最后一道门。
门后，只有一个人的呼吸。缓慢。
方丈要我打败他。
陶要我听他说。
谁也不许进。

en: The elite guard falls. The door opens by itself.
*(from inside)* Come in, disciple of Hōshin.
zh: 精锐守卫倒下了。门自己开了。
*（从里面）*进来吧，法真的弟子。

en: The top of the pagoda.
Wind. The moon over the mountains. And a man in black armor who doesn't turn around.
Hōshin sent you to kill me.
To defeat you.
To him it's the same thing.
Very well. Surround me if you can.
zh: 宝塔之巅。
风。群山上的月亮。还有一个身穿黑甲、没有回头的男人。
法真派你来杀我。
是来打败你。
对他来说都一样。
好。有本事就包围我。

en: …You won.
Now listen, because no one else will tell you.
Beneath your Temple sleeps the Ash Oni. It was sealed three hundred years ago.
Your Abbot knows the seal is breaking. He has known for years.
Then he'll renew it.
He can't. **Not alone.**
The clan always knew: the Scroll is one half of our pact.
What pact?
That I don't know. That's why I wanted it.
My master… lied to me.
In the distance, above the Temple, a column of ash rises.
zh: ……你赢了。
现在听着，因为没人会告诉你。
你的寺院底下沉睡着灰烬鬼。它在三百年前被封印。
你的方丈知道封印正在破碎。他早就知道了。
那他会重修封印。
他做不到。**一个人做不到。**
忍者一直都知道：卷轴是我们盟约的一半。
什么盟约？
这我不知道。所以我才想要它。
师父……骗了我。
远处，寺院上空，升起一道灰烬之柱。

en: The clan's pagoda. Night.
High on the mountain, the clan's red lanterns never go out.
Tonight, a fifteen-year-old girl kneels before the Shogun. It's her first mission.
The Jade Scroll belongs to us.
The monks stole it centuries ago.
What does the Scroll say, my lord?
That doesn't matter. What matters is that it comes home.
Always the same answer.
Tonight you climb the wall for the first time. Kuro will guide you. Your brother goes with you.
Not to steal. Not yet. I want to know how many guards they have, and where.
One more thing.
If you see a young disciple, short-haired, who plays the board alone… do him no harm.
Why, my lord?
Because I say so.
Who is he?
An old debt. The clan's, not mine.
Aya grew up in the pagoda. Her grandmother Kiku taught her the board before she could walk.
Kiku died last winter. Her last words were a phrase no one understood.
“When the stone beats, surround again.”
What stone, Grandma?
Later. The Temple wall.
Nervous, little sister?
Shut up, Sora.
Your knees are shaking. Mine used to shake too.
Yours still do.
Both of you. Quiet. The wall guard.
Get past him without a sound. If he shouts, the mission's over.
Like a shadow.
zh: 一族的宝塔。夜。
高山之上，一族的红灯笼永不熄灭。
今夜，一个十五岁的少女跪在将军面前。这是她的第一个任务。
翡翠卷轴属于我们。
几百年前，和尚们偷走了它。
卷轴上写着什么，主上？
那不重要。重要的是让它回家。
总是同一个回答。
今晚你第一次上墙。黑会带你。你哥哥也跟你们一起去。
不是去偷。还不是时候。我要知道他们有多少守卫，都在哪里。
还有一件事。
要是看见一个短发的年轻弟子，独自下棋……别伤他。
为什么，主上？
因为我这么说。
他是谁？
一笔旧债。一族的，不是我的。
绫在宝塔长大。她还没学会走路，奶奶菊就教她下棋了。
菊去年冬天过世了。她留下的最后一句话，没人听得懂。
“当石头跳动时，再次包围。”
什么石头，奶奶？
稍后。寺墙。
紧张吗，妹妹？
闭嘴，空。
你的膝盖在抖。我以前也抖。
你现在还在抖。
你们两个。安静。墙上的守卫。
无声无息地过去。他一喊，任务就结束了。
像影子一样。

en: The guard sleeps against the wall. He never even knew he lost.
We're in.
Good. First test, passed.
I'll take the north wing. I've got something to do.
What thing? Kuro didn't say anything about…
Sora.
Big brother stuff. I'll be back before the roosters crow.
You're not going to stop him?
For three moons your brother has been slipping out at night without permission. If I stop him, I'll never know where he goes.
If I let him go, someday he'll tell me.
Every time he says “big brother stuff,” he's lying.
And he's got charcoal in his pocket. What does a scout need charcoal for?
zh: 守卫靠着墙睡着了。连自己输了都不知道。
进来了。
很好。第一关，过了。
我去北翼。我有点事要办。
什么事？黑可没说过……
空。
哥哥的事。鸡叫之前我就回来。
你不拦他？
三个月来，你哥哥夜夜擅自外出。我要是拦他，就永远不知道他去哪儿。
放他去，总有一天他会告诉我。
他每次说“哥哥的事”，都是在撒谎。
而且他兜里揣着木炭。一个斥候要木炭做什么？

en: The novices' yard.
A low pavilion, full of small mats. Someone left a lantern burning.
A shadow! Alarm!
They're kids.
They're the age I was when they put a tantō in my hand.
Don't let them shout any louder. Don't hurt anyone.
He said that fast. Like he cared.
We don't know Jade Meditation yet, but we're not afraid of you!
Then we play without tricks. If I win, you go back to sleep.
And if we win?
I'll sound the alarm myself. For you.
zh: 小沙弥的院子。
一座低矮的亭舍，铺满小小的草席。有人留了一盏灯没灭。
有影子！警报！
都是孩子。
我被塞进一把短刀的时候，也就他们这么大。
别让他们喊得更大声。谁也别伤。
他说得很快。像是很在乎。
我们还不会翡翠冥想，可我们不怕你们！
那就不用花招。我赢了，你们就回去睡觉。
那要是我们赢了呢？
我亲自替你们喊警报。

en: The novices return to their mats. One falls asleep hugging a wooden piece.
Kuro… why do we surround?
They surround too. The monks, the kids, us. All the same.
Because that's how you win.
But why **like this**? There are a thousand ways to win a fight.
When I asked my master that, he hit me with a cane.
And are you going to hit me?
No. But I'm not going to answer you either.
You ask too many questions, Aya. Just like your grandmother.
You knew Kiku when she was young?
She taught me to surround. And once, in the middle of a game, she started to cry.
Why?
She said the board was incomplete. That it was missing a hand.
A hand?
zh: 小沙弥们回到草席上。有一个抱着木棋子睡着了。
黑……我们为什么要包围？
他们也包围。和尚、孩子、我们。全都一样。
因为这样才能赢。
可为什么**偏偏这样**？打赢一场架有上千种办法。
我问我师父这个问题的时候，他拿藤条抽了我。
那你要打我吗？
不打。但我也不会回答你。
你问题太多了，绫。跟你奶奶一样。
你认识年轻时的菊？
是她教我包围的。有一次，棋下到一半，她哭了起来。
为什么？
她说棋盘不完整。说少了一只手。
一只手？

en: The inner courtyard.
A master makes his rounds by the incense burner. He coughs. He doesn't look up.
They never look up.
That's no ordinary guard. That's a Temple master.
On his next round he'll see us. We drop on him, now.
And Sora? He should be back by now.
Your brother can take care of himself. You worry about not falling off the roof.
Aya drops on the master on watch before he can react. Three shadows surround him.
zh: 内院。
一位师父在香炉旁巡视。他咳了几声。没有抬头。
他们从来不往上看。
那可不是普通守卫。是寺里的师父。
下一圈他就会看见我们。得马上扑下去。
空呢？他早该回来了。
你哥哥能照顾好自己。你管好自己别从屋顶摔下去。
守夜的师父还没反应过来，绫已扑到他身上。三道黑影将他围住。

en: From the rooftop, Aya sees something odd: no one is guarding the library.
Every torch surrounds a **staircase** leading down beneath the Temple. And a single guard watches it, with a staff.
The Shogun said the Scroll is in the library.
Then… what are they guarding down there, so afraid?
No. Don't even think about it. The mission is to count guards, not go down stairs.
You saw it too. They put more guards on a hole than on the Scroll.
Ten minutes. I'll count the guards in the west wing. If you're not back, I'm coming for you.
He didn't say no.
zh: 绫在屋顶上看见一件怪事：藏经阁无人看守。
所有火把都围着一道通往寺院地下的**阶梯**。只有一个拿棍的守卫看着。
将军说卷轴在藏经阁里。
那么……他们这么害怕，下面守的到底是什么？
不行。想都别想。任务是数守卫，不是下阶梯。
你也看见了。他们守一个洞的人比守卷轴的还多。
十分钟。我去数西翼的守卫。你要是没回来，我就去找你。
他没说不行。

en: The crypt entrance.
A stone mouth in the ground. Below, the torches burn without flickering. A summer heat rises from it.
Halt! No one goes down.
What's down there?
I don't know.
The Abbot woke only me and said no one goes down. That's enough for me.
You're defending something you don't even know?
And you? Do you know what you came to steal?
Thought so.
My sister sleeps in the village below. She's eight. If you get through, you get through her.
We didn't come for any village.
That's what everyone who comes at night says.
He's scared. Not of me. Of what's behind him.
I have someone too. And I'm not going back without knowing.
zh: 地穴入口。
地上张着一张石头的嘴。下面的火把燃得纹丝不动。一股夏日般的热气往上涌。
站住！谁也不准下去。
下面有什么？
我不知道。
方丈只叫醒了我，说谁也不准下去。对我来说这就够了。
你守着一个连是什么都不知道的东西？
那你呢？你知道自己来偷什么吗？
我就知道。
我妹妹睡在山下的村子里。她才八岁。你们要是过去了，就是冲着她去的。
我们不是冲着村子来的。
夜里来的人都这么说。
他在害怕。不是怕我。是怕他身后的东西。
我也有要守护的人。不弄清楚，我不回去。

en: Gon drops onto the steps. He isn't hurt. He's furious.
Sorry.
Sorry? You beat me and say sorry?
I twisted your arm. I didn't mean to.
Aya goes down to the bottom of the stairs. There's a stone door, shut with six bolts.
The stone is **warm**. And it beats, slowly.
…Like a heart.
“When the stone beats, surround again.”
Grandma… is this what we prayed to?
Above, the bells begin to ring.
zh: 刚一屁股坐在台阶上。他没受伤。他气坏了。
对不起。
对不起？你打赢了我还说对不起？
我扭伤了你的胳膊。我不是故意的。
绫一直走到阶梯底部。那里有一扇石门，上了六道门闩。
石头是**温热的**。还在缓缓跳动。
……像一颗心。
“当石头跳动时，再次包围。”
奶奶……我们祈祷的，就是这个吗？
上面，钟声响了起来。

en: Bells. The whole Temple wakes.
They've seen us! We're leaving.
Kuro, there's a stone door down there. It's hot. It beats!
Later.
It beats, Kuro! Like something alive.
For an instant, the smoke jonin looks frightened.
I said later. Where's your brother?
He didn't come back. We can't leave without Sora!
Sora knows the way. We have to reach the north wall before the monks.
Now, Aya! There are a lot of them, and they'll chase us till dawn.
zh: 钟声。整座寺院都醒了。
被发现了！撤。
黑，下面有一扇石门。是热的。还在跳！
以后再说。
它在跳，黑！像活的一样。
有那么一瞬间，烟之上忍似乎有些害怕。
我说了以后再说。你哥哥呢？
他没回来。不能丢下空！
空认得路。我们得赶在和尚们之前到北墙。
快走，绫！他们人多，会一直追到天亮。

en: The forest, at dawn.
They escaped. They wait among the bamboo until the sun comes up. Sora doesn't show.
Something happened to him.
Kuro. They caught him. A big monk, with a bandaged arm.
The one on the stairs. The one I left like that.
He was coming back from the north wing. His hands were black with charcoal.
We're going back for him.
The Shogun will say no. A scout isn't worth a mission.
He's not a scout. He's my brother.
I know.
That's why I'm telling you and not the Shogun: the roof over the cells is loose.
Some of ours are thinking something else. A trade.
What trade?
The Abbot's disciple goes down to the village alone every afternoon.
**No.** The Shogun was clear.
The disciple no one's allowed to hurt…
Who is that boy, that even the Shogun protects him?
zh: 黎明，林中。
他们逃出来了。在竹林里一直等到太阳升起。空没有出现。
他出事了。
黑。他被抓了。是个大块头和尚，胳膊上缠着绷带。
是守阶梯的那个。是我把他弄成那样的。
他是从北翼回来的。两手都被木炭染黑了。
我们回去救他。
将军会说不行。一个斥候不值得一次任务。
他不是斥候。他是我哥哥。
我知道。
所以我告诉你，而不是告诉将军：牢房的屋顶不牢靠。
我们有些人另有打算。交换。
什么交换？
方丈的弟子每天下午都独自下山去村里。
**不行。**将军说得很清楚。
那个不准伤害的弟子……
那个少年到底是谁，连将军都要护着他？

en: The next night. The cells.
Two of her people pound on the roof of the old wing to distract the monks. Aya goes in alone, another way.
While they fight up there, I go down. Hold on, Sora.
In the cell corridor, someone waits for her, seated on the floor, eyes closed.
You came back for your brother. That says something good about you.
How do you know he's my brother?
He talks about you all the time. The sister who asks and asks.
He talks in his sleep, too. He says “grandma,” and he says “stone.”
You went down last night, didn't you? All the way to the door.
Do you know what's there?
I know I shouldn't. And that the one who knows everything won't share it.
I don't need your permission. I need my brother.
No. You need to get past me.
zh: 第二天夜里。牢房。
两个同伴敲打旧翼的屋顶，引开和尚们。绫独自从另一边潜入。
趁他们在上面打，我下去。撑住，空。
牢房走廊里，有人坐在地上等她，双眼紧闭。
你回来救你哥哥。这说明你心地不坏。
您怎么知道他是我哥哥？
他整天都在说你。说那个问个不停的妹妹。
他还说梦话。说“奶奶”，说“石头”。
昨晚你下去了，对吧？一直到那扇门前。
您知道那里有什么吗？
我知道我不该知道。也知道那个什么都知道的人，不肯说出来。
我不需要您的允许。我需要我哥哥。
不。你需要先过我这一关。

en: …Enough.
You give up?
I'm tired. It's not the same thing.
Go. And take your brother, if you find him.
Why are you letting me go?
Because something bigger than this war is coming. And the less blood between us, the better.
Tell your Shogun that not all of us in the Temple are blind.
The cell.
Sora's cell is locked. And empty.
Sora…?
In the straw lies a half-eaten plate of rice. With dirt in it.
Someone brought him food. A monk.
The crypt staircase.
Aya. Over here.
Sora! How did you get out?
I didn't get out. I was taken out.
What you came looking for is not what you think, granddaughter of Kiku.
You knew my grandmother?
I brought her messages for forty years. Now I bring them to your brother.
Sora…?
I was going to tell you. The mark on the wall, the nights out… It's her. She asks me to warn the Temple.
Warn them of what?
That the stone beats. And no one wants to listen.
Beneath Aya's feet, the stone **beats** once more. Stronger. Grey dust falls from the ceiling.
Grey. Like Grandma's cough.
zh: ……够了。
您认输了？
我累了。这不是一回事。
走吧。找得到你哥哥的话，就带他走。
您为什么放我走？
因为有比这场战争更大的东西要来了。我们之间流的血越少越好。
告诉你们将军，寺里不是每个人都瞎了眼。
牢房。
空的牢房锁着。里面空无一人。
稻草上留着一碗吃了一半的米饭。沾着土。
有人给他送过饭。一个和尚。
地穴的阶梯。
绫。这边。
空！你怎么出来的？
不是我出来的。是有人带我出来的。
你要找的东西，不是你想的那样，菊的孙女。
你认识我奶奶？
我给她送了四十年的信。如今送给你哥哥。
我本来要告诉你的。墙上的印记，夜里偷偷外出……都是她。她让我去警告寺院。
警告什么？
石头在跳动。却没有人愿意听。
绫脚下的石头又**跳动**了一次。更强了。灰色的尘从顶上落下。
灰色的。像奶奶的咳嗽。

en: The pagoda. That same day.
In the Shogun's hall, three ninjas have been kneeling since dawn. They're the ones who ambushed the Abbot's disciple without permission.
You disobeyed. You endangered the boy I ordered you not to touch.
My lord, we only wanted to bring Sora back…
Sora came back on his own. You came back without honor.
A month on the river bridge. Eating whatever you catch.
My lord. The crypt door is beating.
I went down to the bottom of the stairs. The stone is warm. It beats like a heart.
Monks' superstitions.
I touched it myself. With this hand.
For an instant, the Great Shogun looks at his own hand. As if remembering something.
And your brother? What was he doing in the north wing with his hands black with charcoal?
Don't protect him. He already told me. Messages from a fox. Marks on the enemy's walls.
Sora stays locked in the tower until I say otherwise.
He only wanted to warn them!
Warn them of what? That spirits talk? Legends aren't debated, Aya. They're obeyed.
And the legend says: when ash falls, the Scroll returns home before the new moon.
Today ash fell on the Temple.
How do you know that?
Kuro. Train her. She's distracted.
Yes, my lord.
Kuro has a fresh bruise on his cheek. Kuro never loses.
zh: 宝塔。同一天。
将军的大殿里，三个忍者从天亮起就一直跪着。正是他们擅自伏击了方丈的弟子。
你们违抗了命令。让我下令不准碰的那个孩子陷入危险。
主上，我们只是想把空带回来……
空自己回来了。你们回来时，却丢了荣誉。
去河上的桥守一个月。抓到什么吃什么。
主上。地穴的门在跳动。
我下到了阶梯最底层。那块石头是温的。像心脏一样跳动。
和尚的迷信。
是我亲手摸的。用这只手。
有那么一瞬间，大将军看着自己的手。仿佛想起了什么。
还有你哥哥？他满手木炭黑，在北翼干什么？
别护着他。他已经招了。狐狸的口信。敌人墙上的印记。
空关在塔里，直到我发话为止。
他只是想警告他们！
警告什么？说灵会说话？传说不容争辩，绫。只能服从。
传说是这么说的：落灰之时，卷轴须在新月之前回家。
今天，寺院落了灰。
您怎么知道的？
黑。训练她。她心不在焉。
是，主上。
黑的脸颊上有一道新伤。黑从来不输。

en: You fight angry.
I fight with questions.
Who gave you that bruise, Kuro?
A novice. At the Temple gate, at dawn. I was covering your escape.
A novice beat you?
The blanket boy.
The one the Shogun protects. Who is he, Kuro? Why does the clan owe him something?
Your grandmother had two daughters.
One was my mother. The other died before I was born. Aunt Natsu.
That's what the grave says.
What do you mean?
That sixteen years ago I swore not to tell what I saw one night of grey rain. And I've already said too much.
Questions don't win battles, Aya.
Not yet.
Aunt Natsu's grave. It always seemed small to me.
Too small for a body.
zh: 你打得很冲。
我是带着疑问在打。
谁把你打伤的，黑？
一个小沙弥。天亮时，在寺院门口。我在掩护你们撤退。
一个小沙弥打赢了你？
裹毯子的孩子。
将军护着的那个。他到底是谁，黑？一族为什么欠他东西？
你奶奶有两个女儿。
一个是我母亲。另一个在我出生前就死了。夏姨。
墓碑上是这么写的。
什么意思？
意思是，十六年前我发过誓，绝不说出那个灰雨之夜我看到的事。我已经说得太多了。
疑问打不赢仗，绫。
还打不赢。
夏姨的墓。我一直觉得它很小。
小得装不下一个人。

en: The next night. The pagoda tower.
Sora is locked up at the top. Aya climbs the outside, like when they were kids.
If the Shogun sees you, he'll lock us both up.
Then talk fast. The fox. What did she tell you?
To look at the stones in the garden. The one below the Temple, outside the walls.
She said that's where it's written, what Grandma never dared to tell us.
Grandma knew something?
Little sister, Grandma knew everything. What she didn't know was how to say it.
Once I saw her crying over an empty grave. Aunt Natsu's.
…Empty?
I was seven. I thought I'd dreamed it.
The zen garden, at the foot of the Temple.
Sand raked in perfect circles. No one ever steps on it.
Until today.
The gardener monks have seen her. They close off the garden with rakes and staffs.
zh: 第二天夜里。宝塔的塔楼。
空被关在顶上。绫从外面爬上去，就像小时候那样。
要是被将军看见，我们俩都得关起来。
那就快说。狐狸。她跟你说了什么？
让你去看庭院里的石头。寺院下面那个，墙外的。
她说，奶奶一直不敢告诉我们的事，就写在那里。
奶奶知道些什么？
妹妹，奶奶什么都知道。她只是不知道该怎么说。
有一次我看见她对着一座空坟哭。是夏姨的坟。
……空的？
那时我七岁。还以为是做梦。
寺院山脚下的枯山水庭院。
沙子被耙成完美的圆圈。从来没人踩过。
直到今天。
园丁和尚们发现了她。他们拿着耙子和棍子把庭院围了起来。

en: In the center of the garden, six stones form a hexagon around a seventh, smaller one.
One of the six has a crack. Fresh, from the same day the ash fell.
Six stones around one. Like Sora's mark.
Like Grandma's stitching.
At the base of the center stone, two names are carved, very small. One in a monk's hand, the other in the clan's.
*(reading)* “Natsu.”
*(reading)* “Jubei.”
Who is Jubei?
And what was my aunt's name doing in a monks' garden?
zh: 庭院中央，六块石头排成六边形，围着第七块更小的石头。
六块中有一块裂了。是新裂的，就在落灰那天。
六块石头围着一块。就像空的印记。
就像奶奶的绣花。
中央那块石头的底部，刻着两个很小的名字。一个是和尚的笔迹，一个是一族的笔迹。
*（读着）*「十兵卫。」
十兵卫是谁？
我姨母的名字，怎么会出现在和尚的庭院里？

en: The garden pass.
Down the only way out come the Marble Tigers, the Temple's guardians. They push everything in their path.
Big, slow and stubborn.
Like the monks.
If they catch me here, no one in the clan will know about the stones. Or the names.
zh: 庭院的通道。
唯一的出口上，寺院的守护者石虎正走下来。挡路的一切都会被推开。
又大，又慢，又倔。
跟和尚一样。
要是在这儿被抓住，族里就没人知道那些石头的事了。还有那些名字。

en: Aya escapes between the Tigers. Outside the garden, the fog awaits her. And in the fog, something white.
Six stones, two hands.
Do you remember the song, granddaughter of Kiku?
What song?
The one your grandmother hummed while she surrounded.
…It had no words. It was just a melody.
It had words. Your clan stopped singing them the day it stopped asking.
*(singing)* “One hand from the mountain, one hand from the shadow. Six stones around, and the fire falls asleep.”
“And the fire falls asleep…”
Did Natsu know it?
Natsu sang it all the way through. Just once. With the wrong voice beside her.
What voice? Jubei's?
Ask him. Tomorrow he comes down the mountain road.
zh: 绫从石虎之间逃了出去。庭院外，雾在等着她。雾中，有个白色的东西。
六块石头，两只手。
你还记得那首歌吗，菊的孙女？
什么歌？
你奶奶包围时哼的那首。
……那首歌没有词。只有曲调。
有词的。你们一族不再发问的那天，也就不再唱了。
*（唱着）*「一只手来自山，一只手来自影。六石相围，火便沉睡。」
「火便沉睡……」
夏会唱吗？
夏完整地唱过一遍。只有一次。身边却是错的声音。
什么声音？十兵卫的吗？
去问他。明天他会从山路下来。

en: Morning. A mountain road.
A ronin comes down the road with a bowl tied to his belt. He has a scar on his eyebrow.
A ninja sitting in my path. Bad sign.
What's your name?
Ronin have no name. That's why we're ronin.
Jubei?
The ronin goes still. His hand moves to the hilt on its own.
Who told you that name?
A stone. In the Temple garden. Next to my aunt's name. Natsu.
You have her eyes. I saw it the moment I saw you, and I didn't want to believe it.
You knew her?
I was a monk of the Temple. She was of the clan. That should be answer enough.
It isn't enough.
No. It never was.
Beat me. And I'll tell you what the Temple keeps quiet and what the clan forgot.
zh: 早晨。一条山路。
一个浪人沿山路走下来，腰间系着一只碗。他眉上有一道疤。
一个女忍坐在我路上。不是好兆头。
你叫什么名字？
浪人没有名字。所以才叫浪人。
十兵卫？
浪人一动不动。手不由自主地摸向刀柄。
谁告诉你这个名字的？
一块石头。在寺院的庭院里。就在我姨母的名字旁边。夏。
你有她的眼睛。我一看见你就认出来了，却不愿相信。
你认识她？
我曾是寺里的和尚。她是一族的人。这个回答应该够了。
不够。
是啊。从来都不够。
赢了我。我就告诉你寺院不肯说的，和一族忘掉的。

en: You surround like her. First you wait. Then you close without mercy.
Your clan says the Scroll is theirs. They're not lying.
The Scroll is a pact. A monk and a ninja signed it three hundred years ago. Daishin and Kagerō.
A pact for what?
Only someone who's read it knows. And in the Temple, only the Abbot reads it.
Natsu wanted the same thing you do: to know. She found out. And it cost her everything.
Is she alive?
I've been asking myself that for sixteen years.
The Abbot told me she died that night. She and…
And who?
No one. A mistake.
Jubei continues east, toward the old shrine. He doesn't look back.
“She and…” And who?
An empty grave. Too small for a body.
zh: 你包围的方式和她一样。先等待。再毫不留情地合拢。
你们一族说卷轴是你们的。没有说谎。
卷轴是一份盟约。三百年前由一个和尚和一个忍者签下。大心与阳炎。
什么样的盟约？
只有读过的人才知道。而在寺里，只有方丈能读。
夏想要的跟你一样：知道真相。她知道了。也为此付出了一切。
她还活着吗？
这个问题，我已经问了自己十六年。
方丈跟我说，她当晚就死了。她和……
和谁？
没有谁。说错了。
十兵卫继续往东走，朝老神社而去。他没有回头。
「她和……」和谁？
一座空坟。小得装不下一个人。

en: The next day, at night. The forest.
Aya follows Jubei's trail east. But the forest is full of monks with torches.
Keep your eyes open! He has to be close!
The one from the stairs. The one with the bandaged arm. It's already healing.
The Abbot was clear: bring him back before he talks to the ronin.
Bring who back?
And if you find the ronin… don't let him near Ren.
Ren. The blanket boy's name is Ren.
And the Abbot fears Jubei more than he fears us.
There! A shadow!
Smoke and mirrors. No monk will know where I am.
zh: 第二天夜里。森林。
绫沿着十兵卫的踪迹往东追。可林子里到处是举着火把的和尚。
都睁大眼睛！他肯定就在附近！
石阶上那个。胳膊缠绷带的那个。伤已经快好了。
方丈说得很清楚：在他跟浪人说上话之前，把他带回来。
把谁带回来？
要是找到那个浪人……别让他靠近仁。
仁。裹毯子的孩子叫仁。
而方丈怕十兵卫，比怕我们还厉害。
那儿！有影子！
烟雾与幻影。别让任何和尚知道我在哪。

en: The monks get lost in the smoke. Gon shouts orders at no one.
Tomorrow, at the shrine, you'll meet someone who asks the same questions you do.
The blanket boy. Ren.
You learn fast.
Will Jubei be there?
Jubei went looking for an old man who doesn't want to be found.
Don't hurt the boy. He's the only one who can answer you.
And what if he hurts me?
Then you'll both learn fast.
Fox… who are you?
The one who remembers what all of you forgot.
The Shogun protects him. The Abbot hides him. Jubei weeps for him without knowing him.
Who are you, Ren?
zh: 和尚们在烟雾中迷失了方向。刚对着空气发号施令。
明天，在神社，你会遇见一个和你问着同样问题的人。
裹毯子的孩子。仁。
你学得很快。
十兵卫会在吗？
十兵卫去找一个不想被找到的老人了。
别伤那孩子。只有他能回答你。
那要是他伤我呢？
那你们俩都会学得很快。
狐狸……你是谁？
记得你们所遗忘之事的那个。
将军护着他。方丈藏着他。十兵卫不认识他，却为他落泪。
你到底是谁，仁？

en: The shrine, at dawn.
Two shadows in the same clearing. Neither moves first.
A monk. Alone. In my forest.
It's not your forest. And I didn't come alone: a fox sent me.
…Me too.
You're the one with the fan. The one who beat Gon on the stairs and apologized.
And you're the one who brought my brother rice.
Sora's your brother? He said he had a sister who asked too many questions.
And he said the rice had dirt in it. And that it was the best thing he'd eaten all week.
I'm looking for a ronin. Jubei. He told me to meet him here.
I'm looking for him too. The fox told me to come.
He didn't show.
No.
In the clan they call you the blanket boy. The Shogun guards you like a treasure and won't say why.
Show me that blanket.
Everyone wants something from me and no one gives me anything. Beat me first.
I was going to beat you anyway.
zh: 黎明时分，神社。
同一片空地上，两道身影。谁都没有先动。
一个和尚。独自一人。在我的林子里。
这不是你的林子。我也不是一个人来的：是一只狐狸叫我来的。
……我也是。
你是拿扇子的那个。在石阶上打败刚、还向他道歉的那个。
你是给我哥哥送饭的那个。
空是你哥哥？他说他有个妹妹，问题特别多。
他还说那饭里有土。说那是他一个星期里吃过最香的东西。
我在找一个浪人。十兵卫。他约我在这儿见。
我也在找他。约我来的是狐狸。
他没来。
没来。
族里都叫你裹毯子的孩子。将军把你当宝贝一样护着，却不说为什么。
让我看看那条毯子。
人人都想从我这儿要东西，却没人给我任何东西。先赢了我再说。
反正我也会赢你。

en: You won. This time.
The blanket. You promised.
Ren opens the blanket on the shrine's stone.
Six dots around one, in grey thread.
I know that stitching. Every single stitch.
From where?
My grandmother Kiku stitched it. On the cloth of her board. On the cape for my first mission.
And she only stitched for family.
That crooked stitch in the corner… That one isn't hers. It's from someone who was learning.
A fox told me it was begun by an old hand and finished by a young one.
Who is Natsu?
Aya steps back, as if she'd been struck.
Where did you hear that name?
Bells jingle among the trees. A Temple patrol is coming up the path.
Monks. Yours. They're coming for you.
Wait! Answer me!
My mother's sister. My grandmother's youngest daughter.
She died sixteen years ago. That's what her grave says.
The forest, far from the shrine.
An empty grave. A blanket stitched by Grandma. A boy the clan can't touch.
Ren is sixteen.
…Aunt Natsu. What did you do?
zh: 你赢了。这一次。
毯子。你答应过的。
仁把毯子摊在神社的石头上。
六个点围着一个点，灰线绣的。
这种绣法我认得。每一针都认得。
在哪儿见过？
我奶奶菊就这么绣。绣在她的棋盘布上。绣在我第一次出任务的披风上。
而且她只给家里人绣。
角上那一针歪的……那不是她绣的。是一个正在学的人绣的。
一只狐狸跟我说，这是一只苍老的手起的针，一只年轻的手收的尾。
夏是谁？
绫后退一步，像挨了一记。
你在哪儿听到这个名字的？
林间响起铃声。一支寺院的巡逻队正沿小路上山。
和尚。你们的人。来找你了。
等等！回答我！
我母亲的妹妹。我奶奶最小的女儿。
她十六年前就死了。她的墓碑上是这么写的。
森林，远离神社的地方。
一座空坟。一条奶奶绣的毯子。一个一族碰不得的孩子。
仁今年十六岁。
……夏姨。你做了什么？

en: Night. Inside the Temple.
Aya slips in once more.
This time she isn't looking for the library. She's looking for the staircase.
New guards. Lots of them.
zh: 夜。寺院之内。
绫又一次潜了进来。
这一次她找的不是藏经阁。她找的是那道阶梯。
新的守卫。很多。

en: The crypt staircase.
Steps that go down, and down.
…It's hot.
With every step, the air grows hotter.
zh: 地穴的阶梯。
台阶一直往下，再往下。
……好热。
每走一步，空气就更热一分。

en: The crypt.
An enormous hall. On the floor, six stones in a hexagon around a crack.
Three of the stones are cracked. Ash seeps out of them.
This is a seal.
zh: 地穴。
一座巨大的石厅。地上，六块石头排成六边形，围着一道裂缝。
其中三块石头已经裂开。灰烬从裂缝中渗出。
这是一道封印。

en: From the crack rises a voice, like embers.
…Kagerō…
Who is Kagerō?
zh: 裂缝中升起一个声音，如同余烬。
阳炎是谁？

en: The ash takes shape. Grey pieces, with no owner, move on their own.
What is this?!
zh: 灰烬聚成了形。灰色的棋子，没有主人，自己在动。
这是什么？！

en: The ash pieces crumble.
But they gather again. More slowly.
They can't be defeated. Only held back.
zh: 灰烬棋子崩散了。
但它们又聚拢起来。更慢了。
打不赢它们。只能拦住它们。

en: A ninja in my crypt. *hic*
That hasn't happened in three hundred years.
Are you going to call the guards?
No. We're going to play.
If you beat me, I'll tell you a story.
zh: 一个忍者，跑进了我的地穴。*嗝*
三百年都没发生过了。
你要叫守卫吗？
不。我们来下一盘。
你要是赢了，我就给你讲个故事。

en: Once upon a time there was a monk, Daishin…
…and a ninja, Kagerō.
They surrounded a demon with six stones. Together. Both hands.
A monk and a ninja… together?
That's what the Temple erased. And what your clan forgot. *hic*
zh: 从前有一个和尚，叫大心……
……还有一个忍者，叫阳炎。
他们用六块石头包围了一个恶鬼。一起。两只手。
一个和尚和一个忍者……一起？
这就是寺院抹去的。也是你的族人遗忘的。*嗝*

en: The crypt, before dawn.
And now run.
The Abbot comes down every night to look at the cracks.
Footsteps on the stairs.
zh: 黎明前的地穴。
现在，快跑。
方丈每天夜里都会下来看那些裂缝。
阶梯上传来脚步声。

en: Outside. First light.
Aya leaves the Temple at first light.
Her hands are shaking.
zh: 外面。第一缕晨光。
绫在第一缕晨光中离开了寺院。
她的手在发抖。

en: The pagoda.
My lord, the Scroll is not a treasure. It's a ritual.
A seal. It needs the Temple and the clan.
A drunken monk's tales.
Kuro will go to the Temple tonight and take the Scroll by force.
If you do that, you'll break the seal.
Then step aside, Aya.
zh: 宝塔。
主上，卷轴不是宝物。是一场仪式。
一道封印。它需要寺院，也需要我们一族。
醉和尚的故事罢了。
今夜黑会去寺院，用武力夺回卷轴。
你们这么做，封印就会破。
那就让开，绫。

en: …You beat me.
Then you go. But bring it back.
*(from the shadows)* Bring me the Scroll, Aya. Or don't come back.
zh: ……你赢了我。
那就你去吧。但要把它带回来。
*（从暗处）*把卷轴带给我，绫。否则别回来。

en: The last night before the new moon.
The Temple is emptier than ever. They say the Abbot's disciple went to the pagoda.
Ren and me.
Each of us in the other's house.
zh: 新月前的最后一夜。
寺院比任何时候都空。听说方丈的弟子去了宝塔。
仁和我。
各自在对方的家里。

en: The library is in sight.
zh: 藏经阁就在眼前了。

en: The library doors.
The Marble Tigers guard the library. They push everything in their path.
You again.
zh: 藏经阁的大门。
石虎守着藏经阁。挡路的一切都会被推开。
又是你们。

en: The ground shakes.
The lamps go out on their own.
It's waking up.
zh: 地面在震动。
灯火自己熄灭了。
它正在醒来。

en: I came to ask you something.
Are you going to fight me again?
Yes. To know if you're ready.
If you read it, there's no turning back.
zh: 我来是想求你一件事。
你又要跟我打？
是。看看你准备好了没有。
一旦读了，就再也回不了头。

en: You're ready.
I'll distract the ones at the door.
A monk helping a ninja. Like in Tao's story.
zh: 你准备好了。
门口的人我来引开。
一个和尚帮一个忍者。就像陶讲的故事。

en: You again. Ren isn't here to defend you.
I didn't come for him.
Too bad for you.
zh: 又是你。仁不在，没人护着你。
我不是来找他的。
那你就倒霉了。

en: Why don't you finish me?
Because you're not my enemy.
None of you are.
zh: 你为什么不了结我？
因为你不是我的敌人。
你们谁都不是。

en: I let you go once.
And not now.
Now I can't.
The Abbot is inside.
zh: 我放过你一次。
这次不会了。
这次我不能。
方丈就在里面。

en: *(stepping aside)* Let someone read it. At last.
zh: *（让开）*总该有人读它了。终于。

en: The library. The Jade Scroll on the altar.
No one has beaten me in forty years.
There's a first time for everything.
If you beat me, read it.
And you will understand why I kept silent.
zh: 藏经阁。翡翠卷轴放在祭坛上。
四十年来，没人赢过我。
凡事总有第一次。
你要是赢了我，就读吧。
你会明白我为什么一直沉默。

en: Aya unrolls the Jade Scroll.
*(reading)* "Six stones around. One hand of the Temple, one hand of the Shadow. If one is missing, the seal will not close."
…It's not a weapon. It's a ritual. And it needs both of us.
I know. That's why I never said it.
I would rather break alone than ask the clan for help.
The ground splits open beneath the courtyard. A column of ash rises to the sky.
I have the Scroll.
But alone, it's useless.
zh: 绫展开了翡翠卷轴。
*（读着）*“六石环绕。寺院一手，暗影一手。缺其一，封印不合。”
……这不是武器。是仪式。而且需要我们两边。
我知道。所以我从未说出口。
我宁愿独自崩溃，也不愿向忍者求助。
庭院底下的大地裂开。一道灰烬之柱冲上天空。
我拿到了卷轴。
但只有我一个人，它毫无用处。

en: The same night.
At the top of the pagoda, Ren defeated Kage.
In the library, Aya defeated the Abbot. At the same hour.
Beneath the Temple, the last stone splits.
**At last. Fighting each other, as always.**
The Temple courtyard, in grey flames.
Master Tao! What is that?
What your Abbot didn't want to tell you.
A monk. Just one.
Surround it, kid. Now!
zh: 同一夜。
宝塔之巅，仁击败了影。
藏经阁中，绫击败了方丈。同一时刻。
寺院底下，最后一块石头裂开了。
**终于。还是一样，自相残杀。**
寺院庭院，燃着灰色的火焰。
陶师父！那是什么？
你的方丈不肯告诉你的东西。
一个和尚。只有一个。
包围它，小子。快！

en: The Oni retreats into the crack.
But it doesn't close.
Surrounding it stops it.
**It doesn't seal it.**
zh: 灰烬鬼退回了裂缝。
但裂缝没有合上。
包围它能阻止它。
**却封印不了它。**

en: The stone garden, split in two.
Kuro! Help me!
That thing came from beneath the Temple!
I know. Let's surround it.
zh: 石庭，裂成两半。
黑！帮我！
那东西是从寺院底下出来的！
我知道。我们包围它。

en: The Oni retreats again. Bigger.
One hand alone is not enough.
It never was.
The courtyard. Ren and Aya, face to face.
Kage told me half.
The Scroll tells the other.
One hand of the Temple and one of the Shadow.
Then… together.
*(taking human form)* Like Daishin and Kagerō.
I was the promise they made to each other.
And I was fading.
zh: 灰烬鬼又退了回去。变得更大了。
一只手是不够的。
从来都不够。
庭院。仁与绫，面对面。
影告诉了我一半。
卷轴写着另一半。
寺院一手，暗影一手。
那么……一起。
*（化为人形）*就像大心和阳炎。
我是他们彼此许下的诺言。
而我正在熄灭。

en: *(wounded, arriving)* Ren… forgive me.
*(arriving over the wall)* Aya. Do what the Scroll says.
Six stones. Two hands.
Now.
zh: *（负伤赶来）*仁……原谅我。
*（翻墙而来）*绫。照卷轴说的做。
六块石。两只手。
就是现在。

en: Six stones light up green and red.
The crack closes.
The Oni dies out like an ember in the rain.
A week later.
The seal will hold for another three hundred years.
If we don't forget again.
Then let's not forget.
One duel a year. Temple against clan.
On the board.
And so began the **duels of honor**: monks and ninjas, facing each other so they never forget how to surround a demon.
Until the next crack.
zh: 六块石头亮起绿光与红光。
裂缝合上了。
灰烬鬼如雨中的余烬般熄灭。
一周后。
封印还能再撑三百年。
只要我们别再遗忘。
那就别忘了。
每年一场对决。寺院对忍者。
在棋盘上。
**荣誉之战**就此开始：僧人与忍者彼此对弈，永远记得如何包围恶鬼。
直到下一道裂缝。
